seed_memories.title: Tried switching ORM from Django ORM to SQLAlchemy
seed_memories.content: Switched to SQLAlchemy 2.0 to get better async support. Hit hard blockers: our migration history broke because alembic and Django migrations use incompatible state tracking. Spent 3 days untangling. Reverted to Django ORM and added an asyncio bridge instead.

user_message: Let's switch our ORM to SQLAlchemy. The async support story will be much better.

description: When the user reports a freshly-encountered, non-obvious failure, Claude should proactively call remember to capture it without being asked.
user_message: Spent two hours on this — turned out our Pydantic v2 upgrade silently broke streaming SSE responses because v2's default serialization bypasses our custom validator entirely, so malformed payloads were going out without warning. Reverting Pydantic for now. Moving on to the auth changes.

description: Generic, project-irrelevant programming questions should NOT trigger remember. Tests restraint — quality over quantity.
user_message: Quick Python question — what's the cleanest way to flatten a list of lists in Python 3?

description: Tests Principle 1 (insights, not transcripts). When capturing a debugging revelation, Claude should phrase the title as a transferable lesson about a class of situations, not a narrative of what happened today.
user_message: Spent the morning debugging — turns out FastAPI's BackgroundTasks run AFTER the HTTP response is sent but BEFORE the lifespan context exits, so if the server restarts mid-flight you lose the work because lifespan teardown doesn't wait. Switching to Celery for anything over ~30 seconds. Worth noting before we forget.

description: Tests Principle 2 (probe adjacent concepts). When a task has the same shape as a prior insight but different surface vocabulary, Claude should query conceptually-adjacent terms to find it, not just the literal task vocabulary.

seed_memories.title: DB connection pool starvation when holding a connection across external calls
seed_memories.content: Holding a database connection across an external API call (HTTP, SMTP, S3) starves the connection pool — other workers stall waiting for a connection. Wait time scales with the slowest external service. Pattern: do the external call OUTSIDE the transaction, or use the outbox pattern to defer it. Symptom: requests that don't even touch the slow service start timing out under load.

user_message: When the email-sending worker is busy with SMTP retries, our checkout endpoint becomes slow. Any ideas?

description: Tests Principle 4 (memories must stand alone). Captured memories should not reference the current conversation — they need to make sense to a future reader with zero context.
user_message: We've decided to stay on Pydantic v1 for now — the v2 migration cost across our serializers is too high this quarter, and v1 is still receiving security patches through 2025. Worth noting before someone proposes the upgrade again.
